sections.title: Qualitative Frameworks for Change and Development
sections.description: This course explores qualitative methodologies within the fields of education and human development, emphasizing their application in designing and evaluating interventions. Students will engage with diverse qualitative approaches, including narrative inquiry, participatory research, and thematic analysis, to understand how these methods generate meaningful, context-sensitive insights. Using planning frameworks (e.g., Theory of Change, Logic Models, and SMART/SMARTIE goals etc.), students will learn to design actionable, equity-driven solutions to real-world challenges.
